title: Infinitely many solutions to Kirchhoff-Boussinesq-type equations on Riemannian manifolds
summary: We study Kirchhoff-Boussinesq-type equations on closed Riemannian manifolds $(M,g)$ of the form \[ \sum_{j=0}^m a_i(-Δ_g)^m u \pm \text{div}_g(\vert\nabla u\vert_g^{p-2}\nabla u) = f(u),\qquad \text{ on }\ M, \] where $m<\dim M/2$, $(a_0,a_1,\ldots a_m)\in C^\infty_+(M)\times [0,\infty)^{m-1}\times(0,\infty)$, $2<p\leq\frac{2\dim M}{\dim M- 2}$ and $f:\mathbb{R}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$ is a continuous nonlinearity of superlinear type with subcritical or critical Sobolev growth.
